source: metadata-only MOPS t100sb02_1 discovery; no PDFs or text used
discovery_source_policy: official MOPS listing only; no PDF downloaded during discovery

metadata_classes.quarterly_results_candidate: file has a company-issued periodic results row; later event rows are usage context
metadata_classes.invited_event_only: every listing row announces attendance at an event (forum, broker conference, investor day)
metadata_classes.needs_pdf_identity_inspection: listing text cannot establish identity or period; PDF inspection required

important_limitations: All pairs are potential metadata-derived pairs, not confirmed calibration pairs.
Metadata never decides earnings_presentation vs financial_results_release; PDF identity does.
PDF processing must still validate document_type, fiscal period, SHA duplication, jsd_ready and teammate data quality.
Only FEASIBLE English quarterly_results_candidate scopes may proceed, and only to staged PDF identity validation.
